notes: Test labels do not accept, reject, refit or change a rule.
Reference comparison scores are not reported as failure probabilities.
A rejected checkpoint is diagnostic only and cannot be exported.
Separate direction thresholds must not overlap.

Acceptance is not a claim about closed-loop robot performance.
Counts are rows and may contain correlated samples from one event.
These are offline one-second label outcomes, not online rollout fall rates.
Confirmation, dwell, health debounce and subsequent closed-loop states require rollout validation.
fault_recovery is a subset and must not be added to the four disjoint fault scenarios.
